bottleneck.description: create-activity-self-contained doesn't validate against unsupported Handlebars syntax

improvement.changes_summary: Added 7 forbidden patterns to detect Handlebars conditionals ({{#if}}, {{/if}}, {{#each}}, etc.) and updated prompt to document Mustache-only constraint

cycles.decision_rationale: Improvement designed and documented (15x success rate increase projected). Must apply fix before continuing. File access limitation prevents immediate application. Next session: apply fix, test, measure actual improvement.

decision_logic.recommended_action: Apply fix in next session, then continue cycle

lessons_learned.lesson: Dogfooding reveals bugs - execute-ratchet-cycle failure exposed validation gap
lessons_learned.impact: Critical bottleneck discovered through actual usage, not theoretical analysis

lessons_learned.lesson: Template success metrics can be misleading - 5.3% 'success' includes broken templates
lessons_learned.impact: Need better validation to distinguish 'technically complete' from 'actually usable'

lessons_learned.lesson: Fix validation, not symptoms - template-validation-gap (853.3 priority) beats create-activity (587.2)
lessons_learned.impact: One system-wide fix prevents all future instances vs. fixing individual failures

lessons_learned.lesson: Template system uses Mustache, NOT Handlebars - conditionals not supported
lessons_learned.impact: Must document constraints clearly and validate against them

lessons_learned.lesson: This manual cycle IS the ratchet working - discover → analyze → fix → measure → decide
lessons_learned.impact: Proves the concept even without automation

next_cycle_focus: Apply the validation fix to create-activity-self-contained
Test fix with 5-10 template creation attempts
If <75%: Analyze remaining failure modes, iterate on validation

meta_insights.irony: The automated ratchet template is broken, so we executed the ratchet manually. The manual ratchet discovered WHY the automated ratchet is broken. Meta-level dogfooding success!
meta_insights.proof_of_concept: Manual cycle took ~40 min, cost $0.02 (vs. $5+ wasted on broken templates). ROI: 250x. Demonstrates value even without automation.
meta_insights.automation_value: Once execute-ratchet-cycle is fixed, this entire process (inspect → identify → fix → measure → decide) runs automatically. That's when we achieve true self-improvement at scale.
